caption: The drawing depicts a beaded drawstring bag centered on a plain, beige background. The bag has a green top border and green drawstrings looped through the top, with one string hanging on each side, both tied in knots near their ends. The main body of the bag features a detailed scene rendered in small colored beads. The scene includes a blue and red building with a tall, triangular red roof to the right, surrounded by several green trees with brown trunks and green foliage. To the left of the building, there is a vertical fountain or pillar, which sits on a blue and brown pedestal encircled by a blue border, with some green shrubbery nearby. The background consists of a blue sky with a jagged white edge near the top, and green grass forming the ground. At the bottom of the bag, three small houses in blue and yellow stand on a reddish-brown strip of land, accompanied by small green trees. The beaded patterns on the bag are carefully arranged to create the landscape design, with a mix of blues, greens, reds, yellows, and browns. The drawing is signed in the bottom right corner with the name "Frank L. Banks."
title: Beaded Bag
